notes.title: Halloween Wishes & Development News
notes.content:
[h3][b]Happy Halloween, Bigfoot Hunters![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/49dcc585266eea286f14735ab721ddb4da94bdcd.png[/img]

We’re celebrating the spookiest and most mysterious holiday of the year alongside you! May your ventures into misty, haunted woods become even more thrilling and imbued with Halloween magic. We know you’re looking forward to new challenges and fresh content, and we’re excited to share that our team is conjuring up a spine-chilling new update. Our goal is to deliver something that’s not just high-quality but also deeply engaging, packed with exciting new mechanics and content.

Here's a sneak peek into what we’re developing.


[h3][b]Punishment System for a Fair Gaming Environment[/b][/h3]

We're committed to creating a comfortable and fair environment for all our players. That’s why we're working on a behavior monitoring system that will more effectively enforce rule compliance.

[b]How Does It Work?[/b]

The Punishment system automatically collects data and analyzes each player’s behavior based on reports from other users. Some penalties will be issued automatically, while others will be imposed following our review.

[b]Types of Penalties[/b]

[list]
[*]Temporary and Permanent Bans for Cheating: If a player accumulates a significant number of reports related to cheating, their account may be temporarily or permanently banned.
[*] 
[*]Chat Mute for Toxic Behavior: Players exhibiting toxic behavior will face communication restrictions. This will help reduce negativity in the game, affecting both text and voice chat.
[*] 
[*]Reward Restrictions for Frequent Early Exits: Players who frequently leave games early will temporarily lose eligibility for match participation rewards. This measure promotes accountability, enhances team-based outcomes, and discourages early exits.
[/list]

[b]Purpose of the System[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/91777208f9c4fc316827ca0d5c3aac6ed40e2626.png[/img]

We’re confident these measures will help create a more enjoyable environment for all and allow everyone to have a better gaming experience.


[h3][b]Weapon Handling and Shooting Mechanics[/b]
[/h3]

In our next update, we’re focused on enhancing the gameplay experience related to weapon handling. These changes aim to improve the realism, precision, and enjoyment of shooting, making each weapon more unique and intuitive.

[b]Enhanced Muzzle Flash Effects:[/b]

Muzzle flashes now feature more realistic lighting and particle effects, creating sharper, more immersive visuals with every shot.

[b]Unique Deterministic Recoil Patterns:[/b]

Each weapon now has a unique, deterministic recoil pattern, allowing for precise hit registration on the server and better control of shooting.

[b]Stability and Reliability of Shooting System:[/b]

We’re also working on making the shooting and reload systems more reliable and less dependent on ping by using local prediction and server validation. This will improve system stability and responsiveness, delivering a smoother experience even with unstable connections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/66db1d4baaec2b149d0851cc9630de75f288fe7e.gif[/img]

We are grateful to each of you for staying with us and helping us improve. Your support and feedback are invaluable to us!

notes.title: DEV NEWS: Development progress and announcement of some features
notes.content:
Hey, BIGFOOT hunters! 
It's been a while since our last update, and we’re excited to finally share what’s been cooking behind the scenes. We’ve been hard at work on some incredible new features that we know you’ll love, and we can’t wait to dive into them with you.

First up, we’re revamping our entire backend system to make it more flexible and reliable. This upgrade is going to squash those annoying bugs around lobby and game session creation, making your experience smoother than ever. But that’s not all — this overhaul is also laying the groundwork for some seriously cool new features that will take Bigfoot to the next level.

We’re talking about systems that will track your stats and achievements, bringing a whole new level of depth and replayability to the game. Imagine diving back into the hunt with new goals and challenges, knowing that your progress is being saved and celebrated. The thrill of the chase is about to get even more intense!

Here are some of the cool changes you can observe soon:

[b][h3]Player Statistics[/h3][/b]
We’re introducing a brand-new player profile page that’s packed with expanded general statistics. One of the highlights is the pentagon of player skills, which breaks down your abilities by character. This visual representation will give you a clear picture of where you excel and where you might want to improve. It’s all about helping you become the ultimate hunter!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/a09a9265ad2230abf433f1b2c56d96845ffe334e.png[/img]

[b][h3]Daily Trails[/h3][/b]
Get ready for a new challenge every day! We’re adding a daily challenge feature that will keep you on your toes. For an entire month, you’ll have access to a unique set of tests each day. These challenges won’t repeat, so every day brings something new. Complete these tasks to earn rewards and gain experience, making each session feel fresh and exciting. The hunt is about to get even more rewarding!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/bb1172658c14a7361e3801c8f67d64edaa7aa8fa.png[/img]

[b][h3]Character Upgrade System[/h3][/b]
To boost the replayability, we’re thrilled to introduce a new character upgrade system. This system allows you to enhance your characters through a skill tree of perks, which you can unlock using in-game currency called Wild Points. You'll earn Wild Points as rewards at the end of each game and by completing Daily Trails. This system not only adds depth to character progression but also gives you more control over how your hunter evolves, making each playthrough more personal and rewarding.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/93d3d9b4e63604925549351b4c4fc8d64774207d.png[/img]

[b][h3]Random Locker Spawn[/h3][/b]
We’ve listened to your feedback, and we’re excited to announce that weapon safes will now spawn in random locations! Many players suggested this change, and we agree — it’s a fantastic way to keep the game balanced and unpredictable. This new feature will keep you on your toes, ensuring that every hunt feels fresh and challenging as you adapt to new situations.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/da86c23136ab4f4d39f2d6f53c9073140d4b7e59.png[/img]

[b][h3]Personalized Character Items[/h3][/b]
To make each character’s gameplay experience truly unique, we’re adding personalized items and introducing new ones that are exclusive to specific characters. This means that certain items will only be usable by particular characters, enhancing the individuality of each hunter. Whether it’s specialized gear or unique weapons, these personalized items will deepen the strategic elements of the game, making your choice of character even more impactful.

We’re thrilled to reveal some of the new personalized items:

[b]Thermal Vision Camera[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/62a9cb5294e04e57445286e722615d455e15ff38.png[/img]

[b]Pepper Spray[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/68146e38fd44483505867fb6d4da83c12d51aba8.png[/img]

[b]Ultrasonic Repeller[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/1d9ee5a35e2c76658ad9fd88d7b53ddf273a8e12.png[/img]

[b][h3]Interface[/h3][/b]
As you can see, we’re completely redesigning the game’s interface. The old interface just wasn’t built to handle all the amazing new features and systems we’re introducing, so we’ve given it a complete overhaul. Our goal is to create an interface that’s not only more functional but also more intuitive and enjoyable for you to use. We’re confident that you’ll love the new look and feel.

Our team has put in a tremendous amount of work over the past few months, and this update only scratches the surface of what’s to come. We’ve shared some of the exciting new content you can expect in the next update, but rest assured, there’s even more on the horizon.

We’re doing everything we can to release this update as quickly as possible. However, since it includes so many fundamental systems, it’s taking a bit longer and requires thorough testing to ensure everything works perfectly.

Thank you for your patience and continued support. We can’t wait for you to experience all the new features and improvements! Stay tuned, because there’s a lot more in store, and we can’t wait to share it all with you.

notes.title: UPDATE 5.0.1 RELEASED
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, BIGFOOT hunters![/b][/h3]

The game now doesn't require manual logging in with Epic, your feedback has helped to identify and fix many bugs and issues, and we've put a lot of effort into improving the optimization. We hope you enjoy the update.  If there are any problems, you can always report them using the bug report form in the main menu of the game

We want to give special thanks to our team of volunteer Bughunters on Discord who did a great job of finding issues with the stability of this update!

What are the main changes in the new update?
Fixing the inconvenience of logging in using an Epic account.
Correction of dozens of bugs that arose as a result of the transition to Unreal Engine 5 and gameplay innovations.
Improved optimization and fixed visual graphics artifacts.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/0490341bd09af9798bb9188cbd7c43b122aa3b6b.png[/img]

A more detailed list of changes is below!
All of these fixes and modifications are in addition to the 5.0 update. You can read the description of update 5.0 here:


[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/509980/announcements/detail/3640648066068446735?snr=2_9_100003_ ]UPDATE 5.0[/url]

[h3][b]Added:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Smooth rotation of the flashlight for hunters.
[*] The physical reactions of animals to explosions and shots.
[*] Smooth healing: The first 10 HP is instant healing, then the healing rate is 2 HP per second.
[*] 10% damage resistance when using the Rage skill on Bigfoot.
[*] Reduced the visibility of raindrops on the player's camera.

notes.title: UPDATE 5.0 RELEASED
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, BIGFOOT hunters![/b][/h3]

We have been working on the transition to version 5 of Unreal Engine these months. Much work has been done to adapt the project to new engine systems.

The game now supports the new Lumen global illumination system. Thanks to this, the lighting has become more realistic and pleasant. We also redesigned many objects in the game.

We can't wait to hear your feedback.  You can send us your wishes, noticed bugs, or ideas using the report form in the main menu of the game or in our Discord community.

[u][b]Please completely reinstall the game before playing! [/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=qFGFMB9BO4w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]What are the main changes in the new update?[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]EOS integration and crossplay[/b][/h3]
The game now has integration with the Epic Online Subsystem.  Since there are no dedicated servers in Bigfoot, this is the most convenient and reliable way for us to implement crossplay between Steam and EGS. Linking Steam and EGS accounts is required for online play.

With this update, the profile level in the game will be reset and in the future, we plan to add an in-game reward system to the levels.

[h3][b]New buildings[/b][/h3]

To support lumen global illumination, we had to redesign the building models.  Now they are much better quality and optimized.

[h3][b]New trees[/b][/h3]

In addition to new models and high-quality distant sprites, trees received roots that adapt to the shape and texture of the ground surface.

[h3][b]New cliffs[/b][/h3]

Not only the form but also the material was changed. Cliffs and rocks now blend better with the environment due to the ground texture projection system.

[h3][b]XBox Controller support[/b][/h3]
Implemented all interactions for XBox controller and binding settings but text input using the virtual keyboard has not yet been implemented. We are waiting for your feedback.

A more detailed list of changes is below!

Everything is fine with us, we have temporarily moved to Bulgaria and are finally releasing the first update since the start of the war!

Adding a Yellowstone map, changing Bigfoot's attack logic, and making some AI improvements (we are waiting for their feedback). The game metrics system has also been added, it will help us to better balance the game in the future, check the performance of the mechanics, and fix problems.

notes.title: Update 4.2. New AI and other stuff
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello Hunters![/b][/h3]

In this update, we've focused on improving [b]Bigfoot's AI[/b]. In this version of the AI, Bigfoot will behave more naturally, it will not always know where the enemies are, it will search the area and buildings around, really listen to the sounds, and react to them. Bigfoot now has full vision, so you can use curtains on the windows, cover, and darkness to hide from him. He can also make assumptions about where hunters might be and check for suspicious places.

Previously, Bigfoot during the battle chose one hunter and followed him until he was knocked down, but now Bigfoot tries to fight with all the targets that are in the access zone.

We have been working on this system for a long time, but we will not be able to fully test it without feedback from you. Join our [url=https://discord.gg/5485TNX]Discord community[/url], there are already almost 10,000 BIGFOOT Hunters!

notes.title: Upcoming BIGFOOT Update News: Plot, Game Mechanics, Localization, and Weapons
notes.content:
Hello everybody!
Time passes and our game becomes more interesting and varied. We promised a big update and now we will reveal some more news about it!

[b]Plot[/b]
On our maps, you can find a total of 12 dead people. They all have their own story that you can unravel. Immerse yourself in the lives of the heroes and find out more about these heroes through the various items they left behind. From notes, lost phones, and other things, you can find out the true cause of death of the heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/6a6cb593d15e240a0a5547876e3f9b61674c118e.png[/img]

[b]New game mechanics[/b]
One of your new tasks will be to find safes, as well as parts of codes in the different locations that will lead you to the correct password. In the safe, you can find unique items that you will not see anywhere else on the maps. Parts of the code can be found all over the map, and the correct answer that will open the safe will not be easy to guess, but we know for sure what you can do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/577fbc8f03eb51ec0589985c942b583bc6dea02a.png[/img]

[b]Localization[/b]
You know that new mechanics and plots are being added to the game, which means that we are faced with the task of translating and adapting all the texts in the game. Since some of the translations were poorly done, we realized that those who like this game will be able to approach localization more conscientiously.

You can fill out an application for translation of the game and become a part of the development of our game as a volunteer. In turn, we will definitely mention your name and you will be able to have access to the update very first. We are especially looking for native speakers of Turkish, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Japanese, but also Italian, Spanish, French, Arabic, Polish, and Portuguese.    

Fill out [url=https://forms.gle/AtNPvYV5BcMmKXpu8]the form at the link[/url].

[b]Weapons[/b]
We have implemented a lot of new weapons that will be in the new update. Subscribers of social networks have already seen these renders before and now we show them here as well. Which weapon do you like the most?

notes.title: Upcoming BIGFOOT Update News: Heroes, BRA, and Key Giveaway
notes.content:
Hello everybody! While we are working hard on the upcoming update, which will be released this fall, we are telling you about the new things that await you in this update. This is the first part of update announcements and in it, we write about the heroes and their history, BRA in BIGFOOT. In the end, you will also find information about the key giveaway, so read to the end! 

In the new update, our heroes will decide to unite into a whole organization that will fight Bigfoot!

[b]Bigfoot Research Association (BRA)[/b] brings together the main characters of the game: Jess, Rick, Tom, and Will. Everyone has their own reason to join the team, everyone pursues their own motives, but they are united by a common goal - Bigfoot. 

Newspapers and news reports reported many missing people, with investigators finding only strangely huge tracks and a couple of scraps of unknown wool. The BRA group decided to conduct independent research and find evidence of Bigfoot's existence. Attempts have so far been in vain, and many tourists have already been found dead. They left notes, and some even kept a diary, some were found to have inhuman blood and hair, but DNA tests did not confirm anything. 

What could have really happened? BRA will come to some terrible findings... 

Also, our heroes have become more realistic and interesting. You can see their stories and models below:
[list]
[*] [b]Rick[/b]

In childhood, Rick met a strange creature. But no one believes. Neither family nor friends didn't want to accept what had happened, so many people shunned Rick and considered him insane. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/b781b79155e1fe6ea9b82f48799ca701c4d290a7.png[/img]

Rick's life turned into an eternal exploration, a search for evidence of the existence of Bigfoot himself. He became a hunter, hunted for various animals, studied flora and fauna, but didn't answer all his questions. What if he organizes a group of the same desperate hunters like him?

Every day in search of face to face with danger. And a clue.


[*] [b]Tom[/b]

Tom's life was like a drama film. Chases, shooting, detention of criminals - policeman Tom felt all this on his own skin and was infinitely proud of his work. As well as his beloved family.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/a6835d938d522690957f3d2477073c5a22ecde33.png[/img]

Somehow, together with his family, he decides to go on an extreme trip through the mountains and forests with tents. If he only knew how this journey would end... All his relatives would be killed by Bigfoot's paws, and Tom would be saved, but the feeling of revenge will flicker in his soul...

Now Tom has resigned and joined the ranks of BRA. There will be no more victims! He is confident that he will defeat Bigfoot!


[*] [b]Jess[/b]

Jess's life since school turned into a race for success. The recognition of her abilities is the highest reward that she must know full.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/fc5aae3767cc6a3c6cae0328f30c8130932098ef.png[/img]

As a recognized expert on primates, she has little work in the best science center in the country. She is confident that the Nobel Prize will go to her one day, and for this, she just needs to collect evidence of the existence of Bigfoot. How little for the worldwide recognition of her genius!

Jess arrives at the National Park with her finger on the pulse. Time is her enemy and she must have time to make the discovery of Bigfoot as a species of an animal before other researchers! And she knows that with the BRA it will be much easier for her to do it, so Jess is in business, she joins the association.


[*] [b]Will[/b]

Will has loved programming for as long as he can remember. But what a disappointment he had when the university practically did not give him the necessary knowledge, so Will began to spend a lot of time playing computer games, and after that, he even created a gamer club in his university.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/555dff6355735fa7cb361ce007fee426c474ea62.png[/img]

One day Will realized that games can not only be played, they can also be created, so he teamed up with his friends in one great goal - to make a cool game about hunting! It would be somehow boring to hunt for ordinary wondrous, but Will also adored science shows and saw many interesting animals. His interest fell on Bigfoot.

How to make a game about Bigfoot without having a lot of photos and information about him? Will decides to solve this problem and go straight to visit Bigfoot, joining the ranks of the BRA.
[/list]

That's all for now. We really want to tell you about the development and all that new that awaits you in the upcoming update, but you need to wait a bit and we will return to you with a new story, and soon with a game update!

______________
[b]Giveaway News[/b]

Do you remember that at the end of this message we promised to tell the news about the giveaway? We have not forgotten! 

Already now on Instagram, there is the giveaway for 3 keys for you and 2 your friends so that it would be interesting for you to hunt for Bigfoot together. The competition will continue until 23:59 12.09 according to Kyiv time (GMT + 3), and already on September 13, a random generator will choose the lucky winner and his 2 friends!

notes.title: NEXT UPDATES
notes.content:
Hi guys!
We decided to give you information about the upcoming updates and when it will be.
Recently, we have begun to redo the entire logic of the game because it is performed at a low level. And there is a need to remake it to continue the development.

[h1]What we want to implement in the next updates:[/h1]

[h1]Changes in the game:[/h1]
- Ability to save the game session (not only for a single mode but also for a cooperative).
- New game menu.
- Game chat (In the game and in the lobby).
- Cooperative mode for 4 players.
- New species of animals (the first will be a wolf)
- New weapons.
- Solar battery for charging equipment.
- Players can create the camp and sleep in tents at night.
- Will be added wolves, which will be especially dangerous at night.
- Will be added a tablet in which you can get access the map, control cameras and drones.
- The next update will be on the new version of the engine, graphics and performance will be improved.

[h1]Bigfoot changes:[/h1]
- A new model of bigfoot.
- 40+ animations for bigfoot.
- Ability to sleep in a cave (Can heal part of health).
- Ability to hunts deer.
- Ability to attack players from the tree.
- Ability to sneak and attack from an ambush.
- Ability to actively fight with more than one player.
- Ability to throw players a few meters.
- Ability to steal one of the players.

[h1]Winter map:[/h1]
- Heavy snowfalls.
- Large territory.
- Deep caves.
- Random events.

[h1]We really have a lot of work and here are only two of us in the team, so the next update will be in 1-2 months.[/h1]
